about_the_game:
One swing. One cut. One endless harvest.

Welcome to Reap, the most relaxing (or obsessive?) game about cutting grass you’ll ever play!

Carve through endless fields and watch the grass explode into glorious coin showers. The more you reap, the richer you get—simple as that!

What’s the Deal?

  • One-button gameplay – Tap. Swing. Cut. It’s that easy.

  • Endless reaping – The grass never stops growing, and you never stop cutting.

  • Coins, coins, coins! – Grass drops nothing but pure, shiny currency. The rarer the coin, the harder it is to find.

  • Rare finds – Every now and then, a new ultra-rare coin is added.

Slice. Collect. Repeat. How deep will you reap?
